name: RollingText
description: Link or button label whose characters roll up on hover and focus to reveal a recolored duplicate underneath, staggered per character with GSAP-style eases; an optional auto-play loop demonstrates the roll without interaction.
a11yNotes: Renders a real <a> when href is set, a <button type="button"> when onClick is set, otherwise a <span>. The accessible name comes from a single visually hidden copy of the text; both visual character stacks are aria-hidden. Focus triggers the same roll as hover and shows a 2px :focus-visible outline. Under prefers-reduced-motion the auto-play loop is disabled and the roll transition is removed. The loop pauses off-screen.

propsApi.name: text
propsApi.description: Label text; every character rolls up to reveal its duplicate.

propsApi.name: href
propsApi.description: When set, renders an anchor pointing here.

propsApi.name: onClick
propsApi.description: When set (and no href), renders a button that calls this on click.

propsApi.name: stagger
propsApi.description: Delay between consecutive characters in seconds.

propsApi.name: staggerFrom
propsApi.description: Where the stagger wave starts from.

propsApi.name: duration
propsApi.description: Roll duration per character in seconds.

propsApi.name: ease
propsApi.description: GSAP-style ease name (sampled into a CSS linear() easing).

propsApi.name: color
propsApi.description: Resting text color (defaults to the theme foreground).

propsApi.name: hoverColor
propsApi.description: Color of the duplicate revealed on hover/focus.

propsApi.name: autoPlay
propsApi.description: Automatically roll back and forth as a demo loop (paused off-screen).

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Additional class merged onto the root element.

propsApi.name: style
propsApi.description: Inline styles merged onto the root element (CSS variables included).
